questions.text: You mentioned "Rip out the tub, put in a walk-in tile shower." Does the new shower go in the same spot with the same piping, is it an extra fixture added in the existing space, or does it move so the drain or supply lines get rerouted?

options.label: Extra fixture, piping in existing space
Moved, drain or supply lines rerouted

questions.text: You mentioned a double vanity instead of the single. Do the water lines or drain have to be made bigger for this work?

options.label: Yes, bigger lines or drain needed

questions.text: You mentioned a heated floor. Does the work need a new circuit from the panel, and if so, what kind?

options.label: No new circuit, uses existing circuits
New circuit only for a range, oven, dryer or air conditioner
Other new circuit (counter outlets, lights, heated floor, etc.)
